liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **I Know You Rider** (3 reviews): Acoustic Rider was rare in 1970; the reviewer cites 5/2/70 and 5/15/70 as other examples and finds this one most spiritual; Reviewer calls this probably the best acoustic Rider in circulation [8][9][10]
- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the Friend Of The Devil as very nice [9]
- **Me & My Uncle** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Bob's Me & My Uncle as a nice moment [16]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Reviewer praises Black Peter, saying Jerry's voice comes through powerfully when played in the dark at decent volume [11]
- **New Speedway Boogie** (1 review): Reviewer notes an evil-sounding cut in New Speedway but calls the performance good and snakey [10]
- **Hard To Handle** (1 review): Reviewer plays Hard to Handle on a radio show along with That's It for The Other One [16]
- **It's A Man's World** (1 review): Having Easy Wind and It's A Man's World together in one show is notable [18]
- **St. Stephen** (1 review): Reviewer says St. Stephen is fully jammed out [18]

## Setlist highlights

- **Silver Threads**: rare: 3 archived performances [19]
- **PA test**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **monitors!**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **monitors!**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **It's A Man's World**: rare: 11 archived performances [19]

## The recordings

- **gd70-06-05.sbd.hanno.7589.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 129 min; rated 3.83/5 by 6 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience patches in the recording cost it points with this reviewer; Audience patches make the sound funky, but the reviewer feels the recording remains a worthwhile historical document; Reviewer is untroubled by the audience patches, glad to hear the show at all [9][10][11]
- **gd1970-06-05.sbd.bunjes-evans.28653.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 130 min; rated 4.2/5 by 5 [2]. Said about its sound: Audience patches land at peak moments, but the reviewer still finds the recording enjoyable [17]
- **gd1970-06-05.aud-unknown.Tiedrich-Coulter-Oleynick.109847.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 20 songs; 135 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls this audience recording not the greatest, though it has some nice moments [16]
- **gd1970-06-05.sbd.thecore.4361.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 113 min [5]. Said about its sound: Soundboard has clipped New Speedway start with a mid-song splice; much of Easy Wind jam and Attics is missing; Apart from the gaps, the reviewer describes the recording as very clean [5]

## Around the show

- Pigpen is heard cussing out Bear on the tape, and the band seems angry with him [13]
- Played before a hometown crowd; reviewer thinks the band was still losing money for Warner Brothers in 1970 [14]
- Played before a hometown crowd; reviewer thinks the band was still losing money for Warner Brothers in 1970 [15]
- Reviewer speculates the sound man was dosed, given the sound problems and Bear's troubles [17]
- The soundboard lacks the intro and Dire Wolf, and the first 20 seconds of New Speedway Boogie [1]
- Audience tape fills the missing PA test banter between Cold Rain & Snow and Easy Wind [2]
- Bear is frequently ridiculed during the show, possibly explaining the recording mishaps from sound system distractions [5]
- Reviewer prefers the 6/6 electric and 6/4 acoustic shows over this one [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-06-05.sbd.hanno.7589.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Hanno Bunjes and Uli Tuete; source: Soundboard patched with Audience [1]. Also: Soundboard with audience patches from a low-generation cassette supplied by Uli Teute, assembled via Hanno Bunjes [1]
- **gd1970-06-05.sbd.bunjes-evans.28653.flac16**: source: Soundboard (except where patched with low gen AUD as noted) [2]
- **gd1970-06-05.aud-unknown.Tiedrich-Coulter-Oleynick.109847.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by John Oleynick; source: Unknown gen cassettes from unknown aud source > WAV; see info file for details [3]
- **gd1970-06-05.sbd.thecore.4361.shnf**: transferred by thecore; source: SBD>MR>C>D>CD>SHN [5]
